page.layout: One page of text, two columns of running text with a heading and canons in the centre; margin note at the right beside "Canon 2." (right margin); page number at top right; running head at top centre.

main_text.p: lapsæ fuissent, quidam Timurus latro, quod claudicaret dictus Lenck, i e, claudus, vulgò Tamerlanes, illud iterum ad summam potestatem & majestatem deduxit, universâ Asiâ debellatâ, solâ Sinâ exceptâ. Hic maximas res, atq; penè incredibiles, gessit: imprimis verò Bajazethem, Turcarum Imperatorem, maximô prælio victum ferreâ cavea inclusit, & ludibrio toti Asiæ circumduxit.4. decli natio.
main_text.head: Canon 2.
main_text.p: Causa fuit mors Tamerlanis, quam secuta fuit defectio multarum nationum, & in primis Persarum & Turcarum.
main_text.head: Canon 3.
main_text.p: Posteri Tamerlanis retinuerunt regnum Schagadai & Indiam.

page.notes: The catchword "Ex" at the foot is partly cut off; read as "Ex" with the final letter illegible. "D 3," at the foot is a signature mark. Right margin note "4. decli natio." is set in small type beside the Canon 2 heading. Some letters in the Latin words are doubtful due to the small type and print wear, notably "Timurus" and "Lenck", which may be read as printed.
